title: Expensive lines per order
statementMd:
For each order, count the lines where the unit price is at least 50. Show only orders with at least one such line.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `expensive_lines`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS expensive_lines FROM order_items WHERE unit_price >= 50 GROUP BY order_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
